title: The US Has 165 Volcanoes, More Than Indonesia
hook: Indonesia gets the fame. The US counts 165 volcanoes.
closing: Volcano fame and volcano counts tell very different stories.
question: Seen a volcano in person?

segments.say: The US tops the list with 165 volcanoes. Indonesia's fame does not match the country count.
Alaska alone holds 130 volcanoes, more than Indonesia's entire total.
The Ring of Fire holds 75 percent of Earth's volcanoes, explaining why several Pacific countries rank high.
